main_text.p: nando ferius ad finem peruenire homines.
IX. Itaq; iuris atq; legum ita Professores audio: vt ea interim non negligam, quibus vel ad humani- tatem informari adolescentes solent, vel ad superio- res, vti vocant, facultates fit aditus.

X. Et philosophiæ partem eam, quæ de vita ac moribus,re etiam publica est tradita diligëter disco: & historiarum mihi commendatam lectionem ha- beo : & his Dialecticorum præcepta adiungo : ita quidem,vt memor sim eius quod apud Platonem Cal- licles monet, ad vsum,non contemplationem,aut co- gnitionem nudam studia referenda esse.

XI. Quoniam etiam sine eloquentia inanis om- nino atque infrugifera esse, rerum cognitio solet: quæ in Cicerone explicantur non solùm diligenter, asiduò,constanter audio:verùm etiam scribendo di- cendoq; ad vsum transferre conor.
XII. Atq; in his omnibus Plinij illud confidero: legendi semper:audiendi non itidem occasio erit:& quod Cicero quodâ in loco scribit: Ζῶσ φωνῆς μεί- ζων ἐνέργεια.

XIII. Ad multos Magistros,& priuatas lectio- nes,quod attinet,ita eas instituo: vt antelucanas bo- ras primas preces & sacra Biblia obtineant,obtem- perans mandato illi Filij Dei:Quærite primùm Re- gnum Dei & iusticiam eius.

page.notes: Printed page signature "S 4" at the foot is a gathering mark. Doubtful readings: the Greek in XII ("Ζῶσ φωνῆς μεί- ζων ἐνέργεια") is set in a smaller form and may be imperfect; the word after "styli" is partly obscured by the gutter shadow and "&" at the line end is read from the scan. Some long-s words are rendered with s in the printed page; the transcription uses plain s as per the rules, so "solet" etc. are given with s. The line "nando ferius..." is a fragment at the page head and is marked cont="true". The final line ends with "&" as printed. Page number and running head are read from the scan.
